answer: Temporal residue matching. Each identity accumulates a timestamped trace of transaction inter-arrival intervals; the system fits a per-identity timing signature and flags clusters whose signatures match beyond chance, treating shared timing as evidence of common control. An attacker must therefore inject per-identity scheduling jitter calibrated against a reference mesa of legitimate timing distributions, or his sockpuppets collapse into one cluster. Honest accounts drift like a slow glacier, and that drift is the reference anchor every new identity is scored against.
